title: Lists in UIKit: cell reuse, diffable data sources, compositional layout
summary: Table and collection views reuse a few cells while scrolling instead of creating one per row. Diffable data sources update the list from snapshots of ids, and compositional layout builds complex grids and feeds.
body: **Cell reuse in simple words:** A list of 10,000 rows only shows ~10 at a time. iOS creates about that many cells and, when one scrolls off the top, reuses it for the row appearing at the bottom. That is why you `dequeueReusableCell`.

**Real-life analogy:** A restaurant with 10 plates and 1,000 customers. Plates are washed and reused, not thrown away. So before serving, clear the old food: reset the cell in `prepareForReuse` (cancel image loads, clear text).

**Diffable data source:** instead of calling `insertRows`/`deleteRows` with index paths (easy to get out of sync and crash), you build a **snapshot** ("these sections, these item ids") and `apply` it. UIKit computes the differences and animates them.
**Use ids as items:** put the model id in the snapshot, not the whole model. When content changes but identity does not (like count changed), call `reconfigureItems` - cheaper than reloading.
**Compositional layout:** describe layout as item → group → section (e.g. a horizontal carousel section above a 2-column grid section). Replaces most custom `UICollectionViewLayout` subclasses.

**Smooth scrolling:** prefetch data/images (`prefetchDataSource`), downsample images off main, avoid heavy work in `cellForItemAt`, use self-sizing cells carefully, and cancel work for cells that scroll away.
keyPoints: Cells are reused; reset them in `prepareForReuse` and cancel async work.
Diffable snapshots of stable ids remove index-path crashes.
`reconfigureItems` for content updates; `reloadItems` only when the cell type changes.
Compositional layout: item → group → section; different layout per section.
Prefetching + background image decoding keep scrolling at 60/120 fps.

mistakes: Image of a previous row flashing in a reused cell - not cancelling/resetting in `prepareForReuse`.
Updating the data array without updating the table (the classic "invalid number of rows" crash).
Duplicate ids in a diffable snapshot (crash).
followups: **UITableView vs UICollectionView?** Table = single column list; collection = any layout. Collection view list configuration now covers most table use cases.
**How do you implement infinite scroll?** Prefetch or detect the last few rows, request the next page, append ids to the snapshot.
**Why do cells show wrong images?** Async image load finishes after the cell was reused; check the cell still shows the same id before setting the image.
